_comment: Diagnostic crosswalk from MindCraft-minted rule misconception ids to the
Eedi-derived ids used by the inherited question bank. NOT SHIPPED and NOT
referenced by the generator: generated items carry only mis_rule_* ids so
the generated corpus stays free of any upstream licence dependency.
This file exists so diagnosis can still correlate a generated item's
misconception with the same misconception as observed on Eedi-sourced bank
rows, for as long as those rows remain. If the Eedi licence question
resolves against us and those rows are dropped, this file can be deleted
Eedi data is CC BY-NC 4.0 -- see data/SOURCES.md and NEXT_SESSION.md SS1.

crosswalk.eedi_name: When solving an equation, subtracts instead of dividing
crosswalk.note: Exact behavioural match: the rule computes constant - coefficient.

crosswalk.eedi_name: When solving an equation forgets to eliminate the coefficient in front
Does not realise that to maintain balance in an equation they must add
crosswalk.note: Matches the ontology's own canonical_misconception_family for basic_equations__do_same_to_both_sides.
No Eedi counterpart. Minted originally; unchanged by S3.

ontology_corrections_filed.current_family_name: Thinks the inverse of subtraction is multiplication
ontology_corrections_filed.issue: Describes a different error than this ingredient's own failure_mode, which is 'solving 3x = 12 by writing x = 12 minus 3'. That behaviour is eedi 1190 ('subtracts instead of dividing'), not 481. The ontology's canonical_misconception_family for this ingredient appears to be mis-assigned.
ontology_corrections_filed.status: filed, not yet applied to Layer 1
